projectList.name: Project Management
projectList.desc: Full life-cycle management of large projects; auto-generate a project Gantt chart from task inputs and schedule (custom editing allowed)

equipmentList.name: Equipment & Asset Ledger
equipmentList.desc: Delivered: equipment ledger (asset attributes / status / owner / maintenance), energy consumption capture & statistics, equipment alerts (threshold / inspection / fault) with handling closure; digital twin view awaits detailed logic from the requester

materialList.name: Material Ledger
materialList.desc: Unified ledger with stagnant/low-stock alerts and BOM cross references

scheduleBoard.name: Smart Scheduling & Gantt
scheduleBoard.desc: Auto-schedule under equipment / staff / prototype vehicle / material constraints; schedulers may adjust before publishing the task schedule

capacityBoard.name: Capacity Utilization Board
capacityBoard.desc: Delivered: equipment / production-line capacity utilization board (occupied hours, available hours, utilization, overload alert, trend chart and per-equipment detail), integrated with the asset equipment ledger

revenueBoard.name: Revenue Analysis Board
revenueBoard.desc: Delivered: revenue analysis board (contract / settlement / collection calibers, settlement & collection rates, split by business line and customer, trend and export)

portalOrders.name: Online Task Orders
portalOrders.desc: Customers submit task orders online against contracts, covering simulation, modeling and testing; business managers may also submit on their behalf

staffList.name: Staff Directory
staffList.desc: Delivered: org structure, job descriptions, one-profile-per-employee, personnel actions

workApplyList.name: Work Permit Flow
workApplyList.desc: Delivered: four work permit application types (forklift, lifting, working at height, hot work) driven by OA forms, routed through safety officer review then department head approval

messageCenter.name: Unified Message Center
messageCenter.desc: Existing todo flows need a unified message center. Delivered this round: message list, keyword search, business-category tabs with counts, mark read / mark all read

visitList.name: Visitor Registration & Approval
visitList.desc: Multi-channel booking and registration (WeChat, mini program, web booking, staff invitation, front-desk walk-in); host / department approval with extra approval for sensitive areas; credential access, sign-in / sign-out closure, blacklist and alerts

zoneList.name: Zoned Access Control
zoneList.desc: Public reception / prototype handover / test / preparation / production & processing / tool & instrument rooms / data center; visitors only enter authorized zones, tool rooms and prototype storage are denied by default

ndaList.name: NDA E-Signing
ndaList.desc: Sign the confidentiality undertaking before or on arrival; no access without a signature; aligned with CNAS confidentiality requirements (customer data, raw data, spectra, report leakage prevention)

credentialList.name: Access Credentials & Gate Integration
credentialList.desc: Temporary / permanent credentials, zone authorization, QR / face / IC card verification, blacklist matching, tailgating and unauthorized-access interception

visitorAuditList.name: Compliance Audit & Blacklist
visitorAuditList.desc: Append-only access logs (retained ≥180 days), emergency reports, blacklist management and sample / prototype handover trail

inspectionList.name: Safety Inspection
inspectionList.desc: Delivered: inspection plans (cycle / owner), inspection records (result and abnormal count), hazard rectification closure (rectify → verify → close) and a safety dashboard

bomList.name: Bill of Materials
bomList.desc: Parent/child structure, multi-level explosion, version control and usage comparison
